description: A custom system-bus D-Bus service runs as root and exposes a Run(command) method; its policy allows lowpriv to invoke the method, enabling arbitrary command execution as root.
detailed_description: The com.example.Executor service is registered on the system bus and runs as root. Its D-Bus policy file (/etc/dbus-1/system.d/com.example.Executor.conf) grants the lowpriv user send access to the service's methods without any authentication. An attacker issues a dbus-send invocation of com.example.Executor.Admin.Run with a shell command as argument; the service executes the command as root.
